findings.F1: When the coin was falling and agitated (30-day return below 0, and the 5-day spread of daily returns above the coin's median ratio to its 60-day spread), a larger day's return measured in units of its usual daily move was followed by a move the other way the next day. The day-clustered slope t was -2.45 over 334 days, and -2.87 with the range ratio added. Outside that regime the same slope had a t of -0.10 over 671 days.
findings.F2: The reversal in F1 is graded and holds across coins and years. Inside the falling, agitated regime, the next day's unusual move was +2.34 % after a day below -2 usual moves (n 83, t 2.75), +0.74 % after -2 to -1 (n 151), and -1.59 % and -1.32 % after days of 0 to +1 usual moves (t -3.30 and -3.26). The per-coin slope t was negative for all six coins (from -1.23 to -3.78, five beyond -2). The per-year slope t was negative in three of four years (2018 -1.64, 2019 -2.51, 2020 -5.70, 2021 -0.49).
findings.F3: The F1 effect is large enough to cover the cost of a trade, but it is a one-day effect. Fading the 40 % largest absolute days in that regime earned +1.07 % per case over the next day (t 3.78, 412 cases), which is 0.19 of the usual 1-day move (5.57 %) and about 5.6 times the 0.19 % cost. On a non-overlapping 2-day grid the slope t fell to -0.66 (168 days).
findings.F4: Over all bars, where the close sat in the day's range predicted the next day the other way. Closes in the bottom fifth of the range were followed by +0.57 % (t 4.21, n 1740), and closes in the top fifth by -0.31 % (t -2.32). The day-clustered slope t was -2.91 over 1448 days, and -2.15 over 1401 days outside the falling, agitated regime.
findings.F5: The tested idea has no size against the cost of a trade. Breakouts above the prior 30-day high gave an unusual move of +0.01 % per case (t 0.03, 256 days) against a 0.19 % cost. The per-coin mean next-day moves after a breakout had mixed signs (from -0.65 % to +2.92 %, every |t| below 1.7). Its book's Sharpe was -0.28.
findings.F6: Weekday effects were not strong enough to count after this many angles. Thursday was +0.47 % (t 3.19) and Wednesday -0.49 % (t -2.69), but these t's are not grouped by day.

ideas.idea: When a coin has fallen over the past 30 days and its daily swings over the past 5 days are wider than usual, the larger today's return is against the coin's usual daily move, the more the coin moves the opposite way over the next 1 day.
ideas.consequence: In an agitated decline, a trader would refuse to chase the day's move and would favour fading the largest up and down days for one day.
ideas.name: agitated-decline next-day overshoot reversal

ideas.idea: The nearer a coin's daily close sits to the day's high within that day's range, the lower the coin's return over the next 1 day, and the nearer the close sits to the low, the higher.
ideas.consequence: A trader would refuse to buy a close pinned at the day's high and would favour buying a close pinned at the day's low for the next day.
ideas.name: close-in-range next-day reversal
